Date of Discovery: two weeks after end of May 2017
Method of Attack: Exploits SambaCry (CVE-2017-7494) vulnerability to install backdoor trojan or cryptocurrency miner
Backdoor trojan opens remote shell, alters firewall rules, opens TCP port 61422 for attacker access
SHELLBIND pings command and control server at 169.239.128.123 via port 80 to inform infection
Impacted Systems: Linux servers running older Samba versions (3.5.0 and later)
Other IoT equipment running vulnerable Samba versions
Attack Vector: SambaCry vulnerability (CVE-2017-7494) in Samba file-sharing server
Indicators of Compromise: TCP port 61422 open on infected devices
Command and control server IP 169.239.128.123 on port 80
Hard-coded password 'Q8pGZFS7N1MObJHf' for SHELLBIND shell access
